findings: Fragile name-splitting in staff order view — item.name.replace(` — ${item.variant_name}`, "") will silently truncate any product whose own name contains the literal string ` — `. No current product has this pattern, making it safe for now, but it is a latent correctness hazard. To eliminate it, store product_name as a separate field on order items in orders.place, or accept the constraint that product names must never contain ` — `.
